summary: Kelso Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on June 4, 2026. The filing details the election of five directors (Paul Cass, Jesse Crews, Laura Roach, Mark Temen, Sameer Uplenchwar) with over 88% votes for each, and the appointment of CBIZ CPAs P.C. as auditors with 97.17% approval. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is present; this is a routine meeting notice.
